title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre - University of California on 1987-06-21
lineage: PCM 601 -> Sony DTC2000ES DAT -> M-Audio Delta 410 -> Soundforge. Transfered by Rich Gastwirt.(set1 Wavelabs 3 - Isotope Ozone raised level 3db to -.1) -> Tracking w/ Audacity -> FFE L6 sbe's verified w/ shntool
source: AKG 414 B/TL mics, cardioid pattern, with windscreens, ORTF -> Oade PS -> Sony PCM F1

ai_review.summary: Outstanding audience recording of a fiery second set where Jerry’s guitar blazes, with crystal‑clear sound that rivals any soundboard tape.
ai_review.review: The reviewer raves about the entire second set, describing it as “crackles and sparks” with Jerry literally burning up the strings while the whole band is on fire. The audience‐sourced FLAC capture is praised as being so clear it could be mistaken for a top‑tier soundboard, making this release a must‑listen for fans of that era.

ai_rating.rationale: Both the musical performance and recording quality are described as exceptional; with only one detailed review, confidence is moderate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Vivid audience capture with vivid ambience; slight tape crackle noted but overall crisp, balanced and full‑band clarity that rivals soundboard recordings.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set dominates the show with high energy, tight interplay and a consistently strong band performance throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar is described as “burning up the strings” and driving the second‑set intensity.
